data.gender_notes: Dilli is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dilli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhil', which means 'heart'. The name Dilli is often associated with the city of Delhi, which was once known as the 'Heart of Hindustan'. It symbolizes strength, power, and fortitude. The name Dilli carries the meaning “City, Fortress” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilli usually hope their child will grow to embody city, fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
